economy.summary: Dawkins is the prime sponsor of House Bill 2189 to raise Pennsylvania's minimum wage from $7.25 to $11 in 2027, $13 in 2028, and $15 in 2029; on the bill's March 2026 House passage he said it has been his mission to provide a living wage for all working Pennsylvanians.
economy.short: Prime-sponsors bill to raise minimum wage to $15 by 2029.

abortion.summary: In July 2022 Dawkins voted no on Senate Bill 106, a package of proposed constitutional amendments that included a provision stating there is no constitutional right to taxpayer-funded abortion or any other right relating to abortion.
abortion.short: Voted no on 2022 amendment stating no constitutional abortion right.

education.summary: In a September 2023 interview, Dawkins said he wants to reimagine how public schools deliver instruction to make it more practical, and supports introducing career pathways and pre-apprenticeship programs for K-8 students.
education.short: Supports reimagining instruction, adding pre-apprenticeship pathways in public schools.

guns.summary: In May 2023 Dawkins voted yes on House Bill 714, which would require background checks for private sales of long guns, closing an exemption from the checks required for handgun sales.
guns.short: Voted yes on background checks for private long-gun sales.
